step1.description: Define the project, add partners, and set each person's participation percentage.

step2.title: Log expenses and income
step2.description: Use OCR to capture receipts or enter manually. Categorize and assign to each partner.

step3.title: Operate in multiple currencies
step3.description: Log in any currency, set exchange rates, and view everything unified.

step4.title: Analyze with Aria
step4.description: Ask the AI assistant for insights, detect anomalies, and plan using real financial data.
